environments.name: Python group summary · version 1

runtime.version_evidence: PYTHON_VERSION in the pinned local image configuration, inspected 2026-10-17. The runtime version command was not independently executed for this catalog.

dependencies.statement: No packages beyond the runtime standard library are required.

platforms.evidence_boundary: Both pinned local image IDs were inspected as linux/arm64 on 2026-10-17. This records image platform identity; execution evidence is stated separately. Other platforms have not been verified.

conditions.baseline: Retain every value and report each group count and arithmetic mean, plus the overall count and mean.
conditions.alternative: Within each group containing at least five rows, remove one smallest and one largest value; retain all values in smaller groups. Report descriptive counts and means.

validation.independent_check: The service recomputes descriptive results from the submitted input. Mean comparisons use the stated tolerances; object keys, conditions, group strings and counts must match exactly.

provenance.image_origin: Pre-existing local runtime image identified by immutable digest. Upstream build source and base-image inputs were not captured.

clean_rebuild.boundary: No image was rebuilt from pinned source/build inputs. Recorded execution of an existing image does not establish reproducible image construction.

execution_evidence.boundary: Original local browser acceptance executed the synthetic baseline in this pinned image. Its 23 checks are historical evidence, not a repeat acceptance of the later catalog or another machine.

limitations: Descriptive results do not establish scientific validity or statistical significance.
No independent operator or second-machine reproduction has been recorded.
